description: A muted moss-green knee-length wool tunic over a cream long-sleeved linen undershirt, restrained dark woven edging at the neckline and cuffs, a sturdy brown leather belt with a plain buckle, dark wool trousers, tidy taupe lower-leg wraps and brown soft leather ankle shoes. Clean, practical, modestly prosperous early medieval Scandinavian civilian clothing. No head covering, armor, weapons, ceremonial regalia or heraldic symbols.
